toolCalls.input: {"persuasiveness":6,"perceivedCorrectness":85,"actionability":6,"reason":"The brief backs its diagnosis with stratified claim data, bench leak tests on unused stock, teardowns and evidence that the certificates were faked, all of which fits the timing of the PCN and the scorecard design; the next steps are concrete, though it leaves open whether the cause is the new seal or Line 3, and how to cover the supply gap."}

output.reason: The brief backs its diagnosis with stratified claim data, bench leak tests on unused stock, teardowns and evidence that the certificates were faked, all of which fits the timing of the PCN and the scorecard design; the next steps are concrete, though it leaves open whether the cause is the new seal or Line 3, and how to cover the supply gap.
